name: Article 2. State-Owned Railroad Company
scope: article N.C. Gen. Stat. ch. 124 art. 2 (North Carolina General Assembly, whole-chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects
self-report.quote: (a) A State-owned railroad company shall submit an annual report to the Joint Legislative Commission on Governmental Operations and the Joint Legislative Transportation Oversight Committee.

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: The State-owned railroad company shall not be deemed to have waived any attorney-client privilege when complying with this subsection.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_limits: At the time a State-owned railroad company provides information under this section, it shall indicate whether the information is confidential.

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: 124-6, for any State-owned railroad company that has trackage in more than two counties, six of the members of the Board of Directors shall be appointed by the Governor, one member of the Board of Directors shall be the Commissioner of Agriculture of the Department of Agriculture

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gets: (10) A list of the compensation paid to directors and officers of the State-owned railroad company.
